description: Birthing Pod's search restriction ('mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value') is a hard boundary, not a maximum - fetching a same- or lower-mana-value creature is illegal, only exactly +1 is legal.
artificial_state_elements: Devoted Druid (mana value 2) is the sacrificed creature; Kinnan (mana value 3) and Delighted Halfling (mana value 1) are the legal/illegal search-target pair chosen for a clean off-by-one boundary, not a claim about optimal Pod lines.
4 Forest is more mana than the {1}{G/P} cost strictly requires, to avoid mana-payment ambiguity.
Library contents beyond the two named creatures are not modeled - out of scope for this legality check.
interaction_under_test: CR 701.19 (search) / Birthing Pod's own printed restriction
material_characteristics: Birthing Pod's search is restricted to mana value == sacrificed creature's mana value + 1, not <= or unrestricted
Devoted Druid's mana value is 2, so only mana-value-3 creatures are legal search targets
abstracted_characteristics: Identity of the sacrificed/found creatures beyond their mana values
All board state not directly involved in the activation

legal_actions: Activate Birthing Pod ({1}{G/P}, sacrifice Devoted Druid): search for Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy (mana value 3 = 2 + 1) and put it onto the battlefield
illegal_actions_to_reject: Activate Birthing Pod, sacrifice Devoted Druid, and search for Delighted Halfling (mana value 1) - illegal, mana value must be exactly 3
Activate Birthing Pod, sacrifice Devoted Druid, and search for another mana-value-2 creature - illegal, same mana value is not 'equal to 1 plus'
expected.outcome_if_resolved: Devoted Druid sacrificed, Kinnan put onto the battlefield, library shuffled.

rules_citations: Birthing Pod's printed activated-ability text (search restriction is an equality, not an inequality)
